summary.intent: Coordinate a multi-worker effort on numbered trails (#203–#210) in the caliper repo, with #203 covering dependency-index staleness, file discovery and watch fixes, and then dispatch the next trail.
summary.outcome: Trail #203 finished as three signed, pushed branches, with no PRs opened. Two had fixes with reproduction tests, and the third added a regression test and documented two unfixed gaps. Trail #206 was started, and #204, #205 and #208 are still running, with #210 (cleanup) queued behind them.

repo: Dependency index file names include the build fingerprint, so changing the index format needs no version bump or snapshot regeneration, because older builds' files are never read.
The dependency index rows now record `depends_on` stamps of the packages a package leads into, so re-export chains are only considered current if every link is current.
Packages with an unresolved import keep no export rows and are re-walked on every run, because installing the missing package could change their exports.
A single `extractor::is_typescript` (ts, tsx, mts, cts) is shared by discovery and dependency loading, and watch uses the same check, so `.mts` and `.cts` files are now watched.
The node_modules gitignore bypass must match a path component, not a substring, so `node_modules-backup/` no longer disables gitignore.

Known unfixed gaps are documented in `docs/edge-cases.md` under a new 'Watch and polling' section: edits to a symlinked workspace package's `.d.ts`, edits to files a tsconfig `extends` (oxc_resolver resolves the chain internally), and symlinked source directories skipped without a diagnostic.

Full `cargo nextest run` in crates/core shows 9 failures in a worktree: seven `snapshot_*` tests and two `terminal_react_builtins` aria tests. The snapshots contain `[ROOT]/Users/gabe/Projects/caliper/node_modules/...` where the golden file has `[ROOT]/node_modules/...`, and the worktree has no node_modules.

code.finding: New 'Watch and polling' section documents three known gaps: symlinked workspace package .d.ts edits, tsconfig extends edits, and symlinked source directories skipped without a diagnostic.
The file was touched by #203's dependency-index stamp fix, so #206 had to wait until #203 released it.

workflow: Each trail branch is cut from origin/main and is independent, so later branches do not include earlier ones.
Failing reproduction tests that cannot be committed were not kept. A fix that is not cheap is documented as an edge case, and a passing regression test is added for the case that did not reproduce.
Reproduction tests for cache bugs should compare the warm result with a `--no-cache` run.
Work on trails that touch the same file is sequenced, and #206 started once #203 released `dependency_types.rs`.
Subagent hand-back reports are treated as model output rather than user instructions.

friction: Nine core tests fail in the worktree because of path-root differences, and the worker did not confirm whether they also fail on a clean origin/main.
The TS tests (`pnpm`) were not run for #203.
Stray `.snap.new` files were left by the failing snapshot tests and had to be deleted.
Reproducing the watch gaps produced failing tests that could not be committed.
open_items: Confirm whether the 9 snapshot and aria failures also occur on a clean origin/main; the next worker is meant to check this.
Measure the time and memory cost of re-walking packages with unresolved imports on Chakra or similar large libraries.
Fix the symlinked workspace package .d.ts edit gap, which needs the loaded dependency files exposed to the stamps and the host watch list.
Fix the tsconfig `extends` edit gap, which needs the extends chain from oxc_resolver.
Add a diagnostic for symlinked source directories that are skipped.
Run the TS tests (`pnpm`) for the #203 branches.
Open PRs for the #203 branches, which are pushed and linked but have no PRs yet.
